content.title: Airlock Anomaly | Physical Breakdown to Impossible Exterior
content.summary: Establish an ordinary enclosed space and one witness object. After a routine operation, let a physical anomaly accumulate inside; use a brief blackout to reveal an impossible exterior while the unchanged witness object proves spatial continuity.

quick_start.input_format: Locked Confined Space + Normal Operating Inspection + Indoor Physical Anomaly + Continuous Witness + Impossible Exterior
quick_start.recommended_input: After the polar decontamination airlock completes its routine flushing inspection, warm ocher-colored fine sand invades through cracks in the sealed wall; after a brief power outage, the exterior of the cabin door transforms into a sunlit desert canyon, with the red instrument box in place proving spatial continuity.
required_anchors: Lock one familiar enclosed-room geometry before the anomaly begins.
Place one ordinary operation or control check before the physical anomaly.
Preserve one inert witness object across the interruption.
Maintain the impossible exterior and unchanged interior simultaneously after the occupant is absent or displaced.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Lock an ordinary enclosed space and one witness object, let a physical anomaly accumulate after a routine operation, then use a brief blackout to reveal an impossible exterior while the witness object proves spatial continuity.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Lock one ordinary enclosed room, one occupant and one inert witness object. After one ordinary operation or control check, make the enclosure accumulate visible physical evidence, use one brief blackout without resetting geometry, then open the threshold onto an impossible exterior while the unchanged witness object remains inside so the reveal reads as a rule break rather than a location cut.

invariants.rule: Lock one familiar enclosed-room geometry before the anomaly begins.
invariants.ablation_failure: A changing room cannot prove which rule broke.

invariants.rule: Place one ordinary operation or control check before the physical anomaly.
invariants.purpose: Creates a familiar action baseline and directs attention inside the locked room.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting with unexplained material effects weakens the ordinary-to-impossible escalation.

invariants.rule: Make the enclosure accumulate physical evidence before the threshold opens.
invariants.purpose: Proves the event is not merely a display glitch.
invariants.ablation_failure: An instant portal lacks escalation and material causality.

invariants.rule: Preserve one inert witness object across the interruption.
invariants.ablation_failure: If everything changes, the reveal can read as a location cut.

invariants.rule: Hold the impossible exterior and unchanged interior together after the occupant is absent or displaced.
invariants.ablation_failure: A quick exterior insert cannot establish spatial contradiction.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source male passenger and paper bag
source cloud doorway and exact disappearance
